name: Hashtag Web3
description: Hashtag Web3 is the premier Web3 job board, blockchain career resource platform, and decentralized talent intelligence network. Programmatically browse 3,000+ blockchain, crypto, DeFi, and DAO jobs, 200+ technical glossary terms, salary benchmarks, and global crypto events.

intent_triggers: Find Web3, crypto, blockchain, Solidity, Rust, DeFi, or DAO jobs
Search companies hiring in Web3 or blockchain ecosystems
Look up definitions of blockchain, cryptographic, consensus, or DeFi concepts
Find upcoming crypto conferences, hackathons, and developer summits
Retrieve real-time crypto industry news and protocol announcements
Calculate or benchmark Web3 salaries and compensation
when_to_use.guidance: Query /api/jobs for employment opportunities with optional search or tag filters. Query /api/glossary for authoritative definitions. Query /api/events for hackathons and conferences. Query /api/news for daily industry headlines.

capabilities.name: Job Search
capabilities.description: Search verified Web3 job listings across blockchain, crypto, DeFi, and DAO companies. Supports full-text search, tag filtering, company filtering, and pagination.

parameters.search: Keyword search across job title, company, or tags (e.g. Solidity, Remote, Rust)
parameters.tag: Technology or ecosystem tag (e.g. Ethereum, Solana, DeFi, Security)

capabilities.name: Web3 Events & Conferences
capabilities.description: List and search global crypto conferences, hackathons, developer summits, and virtual meetups.

parameters.search: Search term for event name, city, or description
parameters.type: Event format: conference, hackathon, meetup, or online

capabilities.name: Web3 Glossary & Definitions
capabilities.description: Search 200+ technical Web3 glossary terms covering consensus, DeFi, cryptography, and tokenomics.

parameters.search: Term name or definition query (e.g. Zero Knowledge, AMM, Proof of Stake)
parameters.category: Filter by category (e.g. DeFi, Cryptography, Consensus)

capabilities.name: Crypto News Feed
capabilities.description: Aggregated headlines from top blockchain and crypto publications, updated daily.

capabilities.name: Company Directory
capabilities.description: Browse companies hiring for Web3 roles with open position counts.

capabilities.name: Career Playbook & Guides
capabilities.description: 500+ in-depth articles on Web3 careers, salary guides, interview preparation, and technical primers.

mcp_server.description: Connect AI agents via Model Context Protocol by pointing MCP remote client to https://hashtagweb3.com/openapi.json
